title: Remote viewing ICBM sites, with drawings checked against overhead photos
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Remote viewing ICBM sites, with drawings checked against overhead photos, about 1978-1990s at Soviet ICBM sites, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: my my area of expertise was ICBM sites okay big large areas where Rockets were in the ground

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who says he worked as a remote viewer for the US government, trying to describe faraway sites using only the mind, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that his specialty was ICBM sites, places where intercontinental ballistic missiles, large long-range nuclear rockets, sat in the ground. He says that from 1978 into the 1990s he targeted Soviet missile sites and that his drawings were checked against photographs taken from above, which, if true, would mean the method produced usable intelligence.
